listings.name: Capital Region Farmers Market
listings.address: Exhibition Park in Canberra (EPIC), access via Old Well Station Road
listings.otherProducts: Also dairy, nuts, meat and seafood, baked goods, small goods, plants and flowers, and ready-to-eat food from stallholders.

hours.note: Runs most Saturdays; skipped on some Saturdays including Christmas/New Year, SummerNats, the Royal Canberra Show and the National Folk Festival. Held undercover.

listings.hoursAsStated: Most Saturday mornings of the year, 7.00am to 11:30am, with some closure dates listed on the event calendar.
listings.description: A large weekly undercover market run by the Rotary Club of Hall where more than 100 stallholders sell produce and food made in the Canberra region.
listings.caveats: The site's FAQ page still says 7.30am start while the home and 'Getting to the market' pages say 7:00am; 7:00 used. Some stallholders list certified organic but that is per-stallholder, so no tags applied.

listings.name: Southside Farmers Market
listings.address: Canberra College, cnr Launceston Street and Yamba Drive
listings.otherProducts: Also fish and seafood, cheese, bread and bakery, olive oil, preserves, coffee and food to go.

hours.note: Stated as open every Sunday right through the year.

listings.hoursAsStated: Every Sunday, 7:00am to 11:30am, right through the year.
listings.description: A weekly Sunday market on the grounds of Canberra College with around 60 growers, farmers and makers from the Canberra region.
listings.caveats: Free-range and grass-fed wording is the market's general description of what is on sale, not a certification of every stall. Older third-party listings give an 8am start.

listings.name: Orange Farmers Market
listings.address: Naylor Pavilion, Orange Showground, Leeds Parade
listings.otherProducts: Also meats, breads and preserves, and breakfast food and coffee.

hours.note: Second Saturday of each month only. In May the market is held at Robertson Park instead of the Showground. Gold-coin donation entry.

listings.hoursAsStated: Second Saturday of every month, 8.30am to midday.
listings.description: A monthly market for producers from the Central West of NSW, held at the Orange Showground.
listings.caveats: Monthly, so apps should show the next date from the pattern (next one is 14 Nov 2026 per Visit NSW). May location differs (Robertson Park). Phone is only on the Visit NSW listing, not seen on the market's own page, so omitted.

listings.name: Byron Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Also pasture-raised meat, artisan cheese and bread, seafood, pasta, rice, nuts and flowers.
listings.hoursAsStated: Every Thursday from 7-11am at Butler Street Reserve, Byron Bay.
listings.description: A long-running weekly growers' market in Byron Bay with local farmers and food producers.
listings.caveats: Postcode 2481 is not shown on the page I opened (added from general knowledge of Byron Bay); the site gives no street number for the reserve. Byron Shire Council page was blocked from this session. Pasture-raised claim is the market's wording for meat and eggs.

listings.name: Bangalow Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Sister market of Byron Farmers Market; the shared site lists artisan cheese and bread, seafood, nuts and flowers among stallholder products.
listings.hoursAsStated: Every Saturday from 7-11am in Piccabeen Park, off Deacon St, Bangalow.
listings.description: The Saturday sister market to the Byron Farmers Market, held in a park in Bangalow.
listings.caveats: Postcode 2479 added from general knowledge, not shown on the page. Product list is the shared Byron/Bangalow description.

listings.name: Carriageworks Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Seasonal produce, cut flowers and artisanal foods from growers and producers across NSW.
listings.description: A weekly Saturday market at the Carriageworks arts precinct selling produce from NSW growers under a stated market charter.
listings.caveats: Official page gives street address but no postcode; 2015 is from general knowledge (other sites show 2015/2016). Public-holiday changes not checked.

listings.name: Newcastle City Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Farmers, producers and artisans selling groceries and prepared food; no specific product list captured.

hours.note: Held most Sundays rain, hail or shine; no dogs. Check calendar for non-market Sundays.

listings.hoursAsStated: Next Sunday market 7:00am to 1:00pm at Newcastle Showground, Broadmeadow, Griffiths Rd entry.
listings.description: A Sunday farmers market at the Newcastle Showground where shoppers buy directly from farmers and producers.
listings.caveats: Postcode 2292 came from a search summary, not the page I opened. Site shows a single upcoming date (15 Nov 2026) rather than a stated weekly pattern, so 'weekly' is inferred from other listings. A contact phone is on the site but belongs to a named person, so omitted.

listings.name: Kiama Farmers' Market
listings.otherProducts: Also seafood and oysters, gelato, cider, wine, mushrooms, sourdough, preserves and street food.

hours.note: NSW Government listing shows 2pm-5pm each Wednesday through 30 June 2027. Another listing says 3-6pm in summer and 2-5pm in winter.

listings.hoursAsStated: Every Wednesday, 2:00pm to 5:00pm (NSW Government events listing, 8 July 2026 to 30 June 2027).
listings.description: A Wednesday afternoon market by the beach in Kiama selling seasonal produce direct from local growers and producers.
listings.caveats: No standalone official website; only Facebook link. Summer vs winter hours conflict between sources; verify. Street number not given (Manning Street, near Surf Beach).

listings.name: Bermagui Growers and Makers Market (Bermi Market)
listings.address: Bermagui Country Club, cnr Lamont and Tuross Streets
listings.otherProducts: Farm-fresh produce, ready-to-eat food and take-home meals, drinks, crafts and handmade goods.

hours.note: Weekly from October to May (starting 8 Oct 2026); monthly from June to September. Goes ahead inside the Country Club if raining.

listings.hoursAsStated: Weekly Thursdays 3:30pm to 5:30pm, October to May; monthly June to September.
listings.description: A relaxed Thursday-afternoon market on the old bowling green at the Bermagui Country Club.
listings.caveats: Sapphire Coast tourism page says the season is October to April while the market's own site says October to May; own site used. Address comes from the tourism page.

listings.name: Growers Hub Riverina Farmers Markets
listings.otherProducts: Farmer-run, not-for-profit co-operative with market days and a co-op supermarket stocking products from small-scale Riverina producers.

hours.note: These are the farmers market sessions. The co-operative supermarket is open Mon-Fri 9am-6pm and Sat 9am-1pm.

listings.hoursAsStated: Farmers Markets Thursday 12-6pm and Saturday 9am-1pm; co-op supermarket open 6 days (Mon-Fri 9am-6pm, Sat 9am-1pm).
listings.description: A farmer-run food hub in Wagga Wagga with Thursday and Saturday farmers markets and a co-operative shop for local producers.
listings.caveats: Specific product categories not itemised on pages I opened. Phone is published on the hub's own Find Us page.

listings.name: Bellingen Growers Market
listings.address: Bellingen Showgrounds, cnr Black Street and Hammond Street
listings.otherProducts: Also gourmet mushrooms, herbs, bread, meats, condiments and jams, seedlings, plants, coffee and hot meals.

hours.note: Every Saturday except the third Saturday of the month.

listings.hoursAsStated: Every Saturday morning except the 3rd Saturday, 7:30am to 11:30am.
listings.description: A volunteer-run village market at the Bellingen Showgrounds selling local fruit, vegetables and other fresh food.
listings.caveats: The market describes stock as organic and non-organic mixed, so no organic tag applied. Postcode confirmed on NSW Government listing.

listings.name: Armidale Farmers' Market
listings.otherProducts: Fresh seasonal produce, homemade gourmet food, plants, coffee and live music.

hours.note: Second Sunday of each month only.

listings.hoursAsStated: Second Sunday of each month, 8:30am to 12:30pm at Curtis Park.
listings.description: A monthly Sunday market in Curtis Park, Armidale, with fresh produce and local food.
listings.caveats: No street address on the site; third-party listings differ (Faulkner Street vs Dumaresq Street), so only the park name is given.

listings.name: Farm Club Australia (Snake Creek Cattle Company farm gate)
listings.otherProducts: On-site bakery, gourmet pies and coffee made with pasture-raised meats and garden produce; cafe and edible garden. Sale of raw beef, lamb, pork or eggs was not confirmed on its own site.
listings.description: A family-run Southern Highlands farm near Moss Vale whose farm gate runs a cafe and bakery using its own pasture-raised meat.
listings.caveats: Primarily a cafe/bakery rather than a retail farm shop; a tourism listing (not opened) mentions beef, lamb, pork and eggs, so confirm what can be bought to take home before listing under those products.

unverified.name: Bega Produce Market
unverified.why: Tourism snippets say Fridays 8am-1pm at Littleton Gardens, Zingel Place, but the sapphirecoast.com.au page returned 'not found' and no current page was opened.

unverified.name: Mudgee Farmers' Market
unverified.why: Visit Mudgee Region page shows Robertson Park, Market Street and dates 21 Nov and 19 Dec 2026 (third Saturdays) but no opening hours were visible.

unverified.name: Shields Orchard
unverified.why: Own site says pick-your-own bookings closed for 2026 due to crop failure; seasonal and uncertain.

unverified.name: Pine Crest Orchard
unverified.why: Own site reports very little fruit for 2026-27 season; not confirmed operating normally.

unverified.name: Huntley Berry Farm
unverified.why: Site says closed until November 2026; reopening date and hours not confirmed.

unverified.name: SAGE Farmers Market Moruya
unverified.why: Search snippets only (Tuesdays 3pm at Riverside Park); no page opened.

unverified.name: Lismore Farmers Market
unverified.why: Search snippets only (116 Alexandra Parade North, Saturdays); no hours found and no page opened.

unverified.name: Arden Farm Produce
unverified.why: Council directory page blocked (access denied); only a snippet says it sells grass-fed beef, chicken and eggs.

unverified.name: Riverview Produce
unverified.why: Snippet says farm-door shop; own site opened but is a stock-feed/pet shop catalogue and does not confirm farm-gate produce or hours.

unverified.name: Byron Shire Council Byron Farmers Market page
unverified.why: Not a separate business; council page blocked (access denied) so council hours (7-11am) were not verified there.
